name: brand-ops-team
description: A five-role expert team for brand e-commerce operations: data insight, member CRM, content seeding, channel governance and industry playbooks, bundled with 23 battle-tested skills.

author.name: 凯淳股份 WISE 技术交付中心

displayDescription.en: A five-role expert team covering data insight, member CRM, content seeding, channel governance and six industry playbooks for brand e-commerce, bundled with 23 ready-to-run skills.
displayDescription.zh: 品牌电商全链路运营专家团，覆盖数据洞察、会员运营、内容种草、渠道治理与六大行业打法，内置23个实战技能开箱即用。

defaultInitPrompt.en: I run a brand e-commerce business. Review my operations data and give me action recommendations.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我是品牌电商运营负责人，帮我梳理经营数据并给出行动建议。

quickPrompts.en: I run a brand e-commerce business. Review my operations data and give me action recommendations.
quickPrompts.zh: 我是品牌电商运营负责人，帮我梳理经营数据并给出行动建议。

quickPrompts.en: Run a promo review for me: GMV, channel contribution, returns and next-round actions.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我做一次大促复盘：GMV、渠道贡献、退货情况与下一轮行动。

quickPrompts.en: Draft a quarterly plan for member segmentation, lifecycle marketing and private-domain outreach.
quickPrompts.zh: 给我一份会员分群、生命周期营销与私域触达的季度运营计划。
